_comment: Dugout Draft boons (Update 9, src/core/boons.gd). After a boss the manager picks 1 of 3; a boon lasts for the rest of the game and is never offered twice. 'effect' keys: damage, attack_speed, range, crit, energy_regen, draw_speed, card_cooldown, coin_mult (summed into RunState.modifier_total); shield and run_limit (applied once when taken, saved with the run); first_card_refund, wave_draw, wave_energy, home_slow + home_radius, boss_damage (read by Battle every wave/frame); card_level + categories (RunState.card_level). 'ai_value' steers the autopilot's pick.

boons.name: Quick Release
boons.text: +15% throw rate for the whole team.

boons.name: Long Toss
boons.text: +12% throwing range for the whole team.

boons.name: Sharp Eyes
boons.text: +10% critical hit chance for the whole team.

boons.name: Rally Caps
boons.text: Outs pay +30% coins for the dugout.

boons.name: Leadoff Discount
boons.text: The first card you play each wave refunds 2 energy.

boons.name: Deep Bench
boons.text: Draw an extra card at the start of every wave.

boons.name: Fresh Arms
boons.text: Card cooldowns are 30% shorter, signature cards included.

boons.name: Infield In
boons.text: Runners within 9 m of home plate are 25% slower.

boons.name: Pep Talk
boons.text: +2 energy at the start of every wave.

boons.name: Slugger's Clinic
boons.text: Every Offense and Utility card in your deck is 1 level higher.

boons.name: Gold Glove Clinic
boons.text: Every Defense and Control card in your deck is 1 level higher.

boons.name: Extra Innings
boons.text: Allow 1 more run before the game is over.

boons.name: All-Star Break
boons.text: +10% damage, throw rate and range for the whole team.
